post.originalText:
Greetings from the Khlaseek side 🚀🔥💜

Here's a tutorial video of widget animation made with @jittervideo using the jitter AI powered by OPUS 5.5.

AI assists with the motion and you get to tweak it to your liking. 

PROMPT: the card should scale in from 30% to 100% scale and it should go from Invisible to visible. every detail slide in orderly one after the other when the card settles in scale. the graph line animates in like a line path. the glow at the back becomes visible as the card details slides in. the two rectangles move accross the screen at slightly different timing giving it this light effect.
